rules.sourceFiles: non-test .swift, .m and .h files, generated and vendored directories excluded
rules.screens: UIKit view controllers (a class whose superclass ends in ViewController, or ObjC @interface of one) plus TCA features (@Reducer types), outside test paths
rules.uikitControllers: classes whose superclass name ends in ViewController, TableViewController, CollectionViewController, HostingController or PageViewController
rules.swiftuiViews: structs conforming to View (every View, not only screens)
rules.coordinators: type declarations (class, struct, protocol, enum, actor) whose name contains 'Coordinator', outside test paths
rules.requestTypes: struct/class/enum declarations conforming to a protocol ending in 'Request', in files that mention APIClientRequest
rules.endpoints: distinct normalized paths from resourceName/path/endpoint properties, let-path literals and URL(string:)/appendingPathComponent calls; \(constant) interpolations resolved when the constant has one literal value
rules.events: distinct case names (or raw values) of enums whose name ends in Event, Events, Analytics, AnalyticsEvent or TrackingEvent, plus string literals passed to logEvent/trackEvent/track
rules.webLinks: absolute http(s) URLs opened with URL(string:) outside request types whose path has no /api/, /vN/, /rest/ or /graphql segment (help, legal and marketing pages)
rules.stringKeys: keys in .xcstrings catalogs plus keys of .strings files in *.lproj folders (union of locales)
rules.locales: locales present in any string catalog
rules.storageKeys: UserDefaults forKey literals, @AppStorage keys, Realm and SwiftData model classes, Core Data entities, and one row per file using Keychain APIs (one row per distinct kind and key)
rules.maestroFlows: YAML files containing an appId: header and at least one Maestro command
rules.dependencies: distinct remote packages pinned in Package.resolved or Podfile.lock
rules.targets: PBXNativeTarget entries in every .xcodeproj except Pods
rules.code: scc: code lines per language, generated and vendored directories excluded; summed over programming languages only (JSON, YAML, Markdown and other data formats are listed, not counted)

notes: Endpoints built at runtime (HATEOAS links, server-provided URLs, string concatenation across functions) are not visible to this scan.
SwiftUI views are listed separately because most are sub-views, not screens; the map step decides which are screens.
